answer: Random audit with slashing: each agent stakes POA it pays itself, and every epoch a verifiable random pulse picks 5% of agents for a peer re-check of their work. A failed audit burns the stake and freezes rewards, so the sybil operator must lock fresh capital in every fake identity, and expected loss grows linearly with the count. Honest agents keep their nectar. It survives auditor collusion because auditors are drawn from the cedar-slow, year-old established set, not newcomers.
